# OJ Auto Detailing — API (AWS Lambda + API Gateway HTTP API)
#
# Prerequisites:
#   1. AWS credentials configured (aws configure / IAM role)
#   2. Export secrets before deploy:
#        export RESEND_API_KEY=re_...
#        export RESEND_FROM="OJ Auto Detailing <quotes@oj-auto-detailing.com.au>"
#        export CLOUDFRONT_ORIGIN=https://dxxxxxxxx.cloudfront.net
#   3. Build the bundle: pnpm --filter @oj-detailing/api build
#
# Deploy:
#   pnpm --filter @oj-detailing/api deploy
#
# Static site (apps/web):
#   Build with `pnpm --filter @oj-detailing/web build`, then sync `apps/web/dist/`
#   to an S3 bucket configured for static website hosting. Point CloudFront at the
#   bucket and add a behavior so `/api/*` forwards to this API Gateway endpoint.

service: oj-detailing-api

frameworkVersion: '4'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ap-southeast-2
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'prod'}
  memorySize: 256
  timeout: 10
  environment:
    NODE_ENV: production
    RESEND_API_KEY: ${env:RESEND_API_KEY}
    RESEND_FROM: ${env:RESEND_FROM}
    CLOUDFRONT_ORIGIN: ${env:CLOUDFRONT_ORIGIN, ''}

functions:
  api:
    handler: dist/lambda.handler
    events:
      # Catch-all for Express routes under /api/*
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/{proxy+}
          method: ANY
      - httpApi:
          path: /api
          method: ANY

package:
  individually: true
  patterns:
    - '!**'
    - 'dist/lambda.js'
    - 'dist/lambda.js.map'
